Description: The evaluator Quantity type stores value and Dimension but no explicit unit_ref or unit metadata. It performs dimensional checks and rejects invalid states, but this is not yet the explicit unit metadata contract required by PKG-02 for formulas and calculations.
ProposedDisposition: Technical resolution implemented: Quantity now carries unit_ref, unit_required, and dimension_check_required; constructors require explicit unit_ref; evaluator blocks missing unit metadata and same-dimension unit mismatches unless conversion is supplied elsewhere. Evidence: cargo test --manifest-path core/rules/expression_evaluator/Cargo.toml passed. Proposed human disposition: accept technical resolution after REVIEW confirmation.
